title: Gemma 4 12B Q4_K_M GGUF on RTX 4060 llama.cpp: 21 t/s, 6.6 GB model, full flags + HF link
summary: NVIDIA RTX 4060. gemma-4-12b-it-Q4_K_M.gguf (Unsloth). Runtime: llama.cpp (CUDA 13.2), also supports LM Studio / vLLM / SGLang. Métricas: 21 tokens/s; 6.6 GB Q4_K_M; 256K native context (practical lower per replies). Uso: local multimodal inference (text + vision + audio) on consumer GPU; OpenAI-compatible server. Límite: Vision encoder-free path still being patched in llama.cpp (related posts); TTFT can be high on long contexts in similar setups. Por qué importa: Encoder-free design (single matmul vision embedder, no audio encoder) cuts VRAM/latency dramatically vs prior multimodal models. Exact reproducible flags (-m ... -ngl 99 -c 8000 -v --port 8080) and HF weights for cheap local deployment.
